prediction_fields.name: total_stabilization_funding
prediction_fields.description: Total federal appropriation for child care stabilization grants under Section 2202 of the ARP Act.

prediction_fields.name: tribal_base_amount
prediction_fields.description: Base amount awarded to each individual tribal lead agency (not part of a consortium) for stabilization grants.

prediction_fields.name: state_minimum_subgrant_percentage
prediction_fields.description: Minimum percentage of stabilization funds that states and territories must spend as subgrants to qualified child care providers.

discussion_points: How does the documented input 'total_stabilization_funding' condition downstream implementation activities? Total funding available determines the scale of subgrants and set-aside activities that lead agencies can implement.

How does the documented input 'tribal_base_amount' condition downstream implementation activities? Base amount provides a minimum funding level for each tribal lead agency, affecting their ability to administer the program.

How does the documented input 'state_minimum_subgrant_percentage' condition downstream implementation activities? This requirement determines the minimum amount of funding that must flow directly to providers as subgrants.
